scope: Engineering regression on an authorized isolated Linux node, using public synthetic fixtures; not a real enterprise pilot or capacity benchmark

source.patchDescription: The initial working-tree archive included new session tests and safe HTTP stage labels. Two recorded, hash-checked patches preserved the internal decode cause, then serialized URL values as strings and extended the tests. The final GitHub commit is validated separately by CI.

environment.cpuLimit: Two pinned CPU cores, low-priority execution, one Gradle worker

limitations: The OIDC provider is an independent HTTPS protocol fixture, not a customer identity provider.
This run does not verify the enterprise login UI in a real browser.
Synthetic accounts do not establish that two distinct employees participated.
No production capacity, real business ROI, backup recovery or rolling-upgrade claim is made.
Raw logs, host details, credentials and business data are excluded from this public record.
